$comment: Entry schema for contributes.formatters (process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_formatters.go and formatter_invoke.go. action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'. The host calls it through plugin_host_format with {formatter, languageId, fileName, relativePath? (only with workspace.read), text, range?, options: {tabSize, insertSpaces, eol}} (<= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.saveTimeoutMs}} ms on save) and expects {"text": string} or {"unchanged": true} (text <= {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes, valid UTF-8 without NUL). Formatters run only when the user formats or opted in to format-on-save for that language; built-in formatters stay the default.
description: Document formatters: format documents of the listed languages through one of this plugin's read actions.

items.description: Monaco language id, for example json, typescript or a language this plugin contributes.

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'.

range.description: Also format selections (the payload then carries a 1-based range).
